name: Prime
blurb: The ranks stop being evenly spaced. The high cards pull ahead a little.

name: Triangular
blurb: Each rank is the sum of the ranks below it. A gentle tilt toward the court.

name: Fibonacci
blurb: Every rank is the two before it. The tilt steepens.

name: Powers of Two
blurb: Each rank doubles the last. The King is worth half the deck.

name: Factorial
blurb: The low cards give up nearly everything so the King can hold it.

name: Tetration
blurb: One card carries the deck. The other twelve are ceremony.
